title: KHR_animation_layers Layer
description: An animation layer in the layer stack.

weight.description: Layer blend weight. Affects all animations in this layer. Must not be NaN or Infinity.

mask.description: Index into root masks array. If omitted, layer affects all nodes.

blendMorphTargets.description: If false, morph target channels in this layer's animations are ignored; morph weights from lower layers pass through unchanged.

animations.description: Array of animation references in this layer.
